thread:
Jules M.: Hi team — opened a tiny cleanup PR that consolidates provisioning examples and adds an "edge cases" section for dedicated capacity (reserved vs preemptible). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4390 :wave:
Aaron P.: Nice. Can you include an explicit one-liner that "isolation_preference" is advisory and that scheduler priority + pool capacity take precedence? Customers trip on this.
Jules M.: Added that line and a short FAQ entry.
Lina H.: Please add a short Python async SDK snippet showing the modern client pattern — folks copy paste that a lot.
Jules M.: Added async Python and a compact Terraform snippet. Python snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodAsyncClient
client = RedwoodAsyncClient()
await client.capacity.create(
  tenant_id="acct-123",
  reserved_pool="gold-reserved",
  autoscale={"min_instances":1, "max_instances":8, "target_rps":250},
  isolation_preference="reserved"
)
```
Aaron P.: Good. SLA/legal wants a copyable sentence that preemptible pools are excluded from the standard latency SLA. Can you add suggested wording?
Jules M.: Added: "Allocations on preemptible pools are not covered by Redwood's standard 99th-percentile latency SLA; use reserved pools for SLA-backed latency guarantees."
eng-runtime: Quick tech note: quantized models on older GPUs may add ~200-400ms for the first few tokens after placement. Eviction from preemptible hosts triggers graceful-drain; clients should implement retry/backoff.
Jules M.: Included the quantization parenthetical and a streaming retry example for JS clients.
Lina H.: Also include a 3-step safe rollout pattern in the migration guide: (1) create small reserved pool, (2) mirror low % traffic, (3) promote. Add recommended mirror % and quiet window.
Jules M.: Done — recommends mirror 5% for 1-2h and a 15m quiet/promotion window as eng-platform suggested.
Aaron P.: Add a tiny troubleshooting matrix: symptom -> check (quota, label mismatch, KMS perms, insufficient pool).
Jules M.: Added a 4-row troubleshooting table and examples of the common error messages.
eng-runtime: Link fix: point eviction references to /docs/operational/eviction-behavior (not the old internals page). Also confirm that KMS rotations can surface as provisioning errors if key scope is wrong.
Jules M.: Fixed links and added KMS rotation note + a sample gcloud command to check key versions.
Lina H.: UX nit: show how to attach a scale policy to the reserved pool so it won't be starved. A one-liner Terraform snippet is fine.
Jules M.: Added Terraform one-liner for a min_instances scale policy.
Aaron P.: Can we include a short rollback checklist (how to demote quickly) and an example CLI sequence?
Jules M.: Added rollback steps and CLI quick commands: `redwoodctl route remove-mirror`, `redwoodctl promote --cancel`, `redwoodctl pool scale --down`.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4390 (Jules M.)  reviewers requested: @Aaron P., @Lina H.
Aaron P.: LGTM from docs side after legal sanity-check on the SLA text. Lina?
Lina H.: LGTM. Tagging eng-runtime and legal for final signoffs. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
